capabilities: Incrementally sync Plaud recordings into Markdown notes using a last-sync checkpoint
Render notes with title, date, duration, AI summary, highlights, and speaker-labeled transcripts
Update existing notes in place via a stable file_id in frontmatter
Store the Plaud session token securely and validate it against the API
Retry transient failures with backoff and skip trashed recordings
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool like Obsidian Sync; it one-way imports Plaud recordings into the vault as notes.
extras: Unofficial and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; uses a reverse-engineered API that may break if Plaud changes their backend; manual installation only (no community plugin store listing mentioned); includes a legal rationale under EU interoperability provisions.
problem: Plaud offers no official API or Obsidian integration, so recordings and their transcripts cannot be brought into a vault without manual copying.

relations.evidence: Sync your Plaud voice recordings into Markdown notes inside your Obsidian vault

requires.name: Plaud session token extracted from the Plaud web app

summary: Syncs Plaud voice recorder recordings into Markdown notes with transcripts, AI summaries, highlights, and metadata via a reverse-engineered Plaud API.
